situations.title: Russia-Ukraine War
situations.summary: A full-scale, sustained conventional war involving high-intensity combat, territorial occupation, and massive state-on-state military mobilization. The conflict has expanded to include significant long-range strikes and cross-border ground operations.
evidence: Sustained state-on-state conventional warfare since February 2022
Extensive use of heavy artillery, armor, and ballistic missiles
Large-scale mobilization of national personnel and industrial resources
Expansion of active combat zones into Russian territory (Kursk region)

situations.title: Israel–Hamas War
situations.summary: A sustained high-intensity conventional conflict involving full-scale military mobilization, territorial invasion, and large-scale kinetic operations primarily in the Gaza Strip.
evidence: Sustained division-level ground maneuvers and aerial bombardment across the Gaza Strip
Complete mobilization of Israeli reserve forces and wartime emergency governance
Highest casualty and displacement rates in the history of the modern conflict
Intensifying high-intensity border clashes with Hezbollah and military operations in the West Bank

situations.title: Red Sea Maritime Security Crisis
situations.summary: Ongoing kinetic engagement involving Houthi missile/drone strikes against commercial shipping and retaliatory airstrikes by U.S. and U.K. forces against Houthi infrastructure in Yemen.
evidence: Repeated Houthi anti-ship ballistic missile and one-way attack drone launches
U.S. and U.K. precision strikes on Houthi radar, UAV, and missile launch sites (Operation Poseidon Archer)
Significant disruption to global trade and Suez Canal transit volumes
Deployment of carrier strike groups and international naval coalitions to the Bab el-Mandeb

situations.title: Taiwan Strait Geopolitical Tension
situations.summary: Persistent grey zone activities and military posturing by the PRC designed to exhaust Taiwan's defense capabilities and coerce political outcomes without full-scale kinetic conflict.
evidence: Frequent incursions into Taiwan's Air Defense Identification Zone (ADIZ) by PLA aircraft
Large-scale 'Joint Sword' military exercises simulating blockades and precision strikes
Persistent state-sponsored disinformation campaigns and cyberattacks on Taiwanese infrastructure
Economic coercion through targeted bans on Taiwanese agricultural and industrial imports

situations.title: South China Sea Maritime and Territorial Disputes
situations.summary: Heightened territorial friction marked by frequent kinetic confrontations between maritime border forces, particularly involving China and the Philippines. Activities have progressed from diplomatic and economic pressure to physical collisions and the use of non-lethal weaponry in contested waters.
evidence: Repeated use of high-pressure water cannons by the China Coast Guard against Philippine vessels near Second Thomas Shoal.
Deliberate ramming of vessels and physical boarding actions resulting in damage and injuries to personnel.
Militarization of reclaimed features with runways, hangars, and missile batteries.
Increased deployment of maritime militia and 'grey zone' tactics to enforce territorial claims.

situations.title: India-Pakistan Border Tensions and Kashmir Conflict
situations.summary: Relations remain frozen following the 2019 revocation of Article 370, though a 2021 ceasefire agreement along the Line of Control continues to mitigate direct state-on-state kinetic clashes. The conflict is currently defined by persistent counter-insurgency operations against state-linked militant groups and mutual diplomatic isolation.
evidence: A renewed ceasefire agreement on the Line of Control (LoC) has largely held since February 2021, significantly reducing artillery and small arms exchanges.
Ongoing military operations in the Jammu and Kashmir regions target militant groups that India alleges receive logistical and financial support from Pakistan.
Bilateral trade remains suspended and diplomatic missions are headed by chargés d’affaires rather than high commissioners.
Sporadic infiltration attempts and localized skirmishes involving proxies occur, but have not escalated to direct conventional military maneuvers in recent months.

ticker: Russia-Ukraine War: level 5 (escalating) • Israel–Hamas War: level 5 (escalating) • Red Sea Maritime Security Crisis: level 4 (escalating)
